title: Password reset via email
description: As a registered user, I want to reset my password using a link sent to my email so that I can regain access to my account.
business_rules: The reset link expires 30 minutes after it is sent.
The new password must be between 8 and 64 characters and contain at least 1 digit.
A user can request at most 3 reset emails per hour.
The new password must not equal the current password.
